mentions.name: Miletus
mentions.description: A personal learning agent, ported from a web app to a Mac desktop app, that asks the user questions every day, emails interesting reads on topics like math, LLMs, RL, and robotics, and helps track progress in learning. Described as working like Conductor, but for learning side quests.
mentions.audience: Personal use for self-directed learners working on learning side quests
mentions.source_excerpt: I ended up building a personal agent that asks me questions every day, emails me interesting reads in these areas, and helps me progress in my learning. It started as a web app, but I have just ported it to a Mac desktop app. It works like Conductor, but for your learning side quests: https://miletus.app
